faq.subtitle: Find quick answers to the most common questions about Madrasio, from data security to setup and support.

items.q: Is our school's data completely private and safe?
items.a: Yes. Your school gets its own isolated, bank-grade secure environment. No outside person or other school can ever view or access your students' records, grades, or financial data.

items.q: Can we transfer our existing student lists without re-typing everything?
items.a: Yes. Our team helps you import all your existing Excel lists, student files, and class rosters into Madrasio in minutes so you don't have to enter data manually.

items.q: Can Madrasio adapt to our school's specific grading scale and report cards?
items.a: Yes. Whether your school uses percentage scales, letter grades, or custom evaluation systems, Madrasio customizes report cards and grading systems to match your exact academic standards.

items.q: Which languages are supported, and can parents set their own language?
items.a: Madrasio supports over 12 languages—including Arabic, French, English, and Spanish—with full support for right-to-left (RTL) and left-to-right (LTR) reading. Directors, teachers, and parents can each choose their preferred language independently.

items.q: Do our teachers need technical skills to use Madrasio?
items.a: Not at all. Madrasio is designed to be as simple as using a smartphone. If your staff knows how to browse the internet, they can learn Madrasio in under 30 minutes.

items.q: How does Madrasio help us manage tuition fees?
items.a: Madrasio provides a clear financial overview of paid, pending, and overdue tuition. It can send automatic payment reminders to parents, saving your administration hours of manual follow-up.

items.q: How long does it take to set up Madrasio for our school?
items.a: Your school can be completely set up and ready to go in less than 48 hours. Our setup team manages the configuration for you so your staff can start smoothly.
